rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when someone does something in a cheerful or happy manner.

example.english: We happily finished the whole meal.
example.traditional: 我哋開心咁食晒成餐飯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 hoi1 sam1 gam2 sik6 saai3 sing4 caan1 faan6

rows.note: Use this when happily means being willing to do the action, rather than doing it cheerfully.

example.english: They happily agreed to help me move.
example.jyutping: keoi5 hang2 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1

rows.note: Use this when happily means fortunately or luckily.

example.english: Happily, it did not rain today, so we could have a picnic.
example.traditional: 好彩今日冇落雨，我哋可以去野餐。
example.jyutping: hou2 coi2 gam1 jat6 mou5 lok6 jyu5 ngo5 dei6 ho2 ji5 heoi3 je5 caan1
